fields.xml:
<${nodeName}
    jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured"
    sling:resourceType="${resourceType}"
    fieldLabel="${label}"
    name="./${name}"
    min="0" max="1000"/>

<${nodeName}
    jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured"
    sling:resourceType="${resourceType}"
    fieldLabel="${label}"
    name="./${name}"
    autocompleter="true"
    multiple="true"
    rootPath="/content/cq:tags"/>

<${nodeName}
    jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured"
    sling:resourceType="${resourceType}"
    fieldLabel="${label}"
    name="./${name}"
    useFixedInlineToolbar="true"
    enableSourceEdit="true"/>

<${nodeName}
    jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured"
    sling:resourceType="${resourceType}"
    fieldLabel="${label}"
    name="./${name}"
    emptyText="Choose a color"
    value="#ffffff"
    required="{Boolean}false"/>

<${nodeName}
    jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured"
    sling:resourceType="${resourceType}"
    fieldLabel="${label}"
    name="./${name}"
    text="${label}"
    value="true"
    uncheckedValue="false"/>

<${nodeName}
    jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured"
    sling:resourceType="${resourceType}"
    fieldLabel="${label}"
    name="./${name}"
    emptyText="Select...">
    <items jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured">
${options}    </items>
</${nodeName}>

<${nodeName}
    jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured"
    sling:resourceType="${resourceType}"
    fieldLabel="${label}"
    name="./${name}"
    multiple="true"
    emptyText="Select...">
    <items jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured">
${options}    </items>
</${nodeName}>

<${nodeName}
    jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured"
    sling:resourceType="${resourceType}"
    autoStart="{Boolean}false"
    class="cq-droptarget"
    fieldLabel="${label}"
    fileNameParameter="./${name}FileName"
    fileReferenceParameter="./${name}"
    mimeTypes="[image/gif,image/jpeg,image/png,image/tiff,image/svg+xml]"
    multiple="{Boolean}false"
    name="./file"
    uploadUrl="/content/dam"/>

<${nodeName}
    jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured"
    sling:resourceType="${resourceType}"
    autoStart="{Boolean}false"
    class="cq-droptarget"
    fieldLabel="${label}"
    fileNameParameter="./${name}FileName"
    fileReferenceParameter="./${name}"
    mimeTypes="[image/gif,image/jpeg,image/png,image/tiff,image/svg+xml]"
    multiple="{Boolean}false"
    name="./file"
    uploadUrl="/content/dam"/>

<${nodeName}
    jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured"
    sling:resourceType="${resourceType}"
    fieldLabel="${label}"
    composite="true">
    <field
      jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured"
      sling:resourceType="granite/ui/components/coral/foundation/form/fieldset"
      name="./${name}">
        <layout
            jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured"
            sling:resourceType="granite/ui/components/coral/foundation/layouts/fixedcolumns"
            margin="true"/>
        <items jcr:primaryType="nt:unstructured">
${nestedFields}        </items>
    </field>
</${nodeName}>
